hypothesis.title: Gradient Boosting and Next-Day Equity Direction: A Walk-Forward Test with Cross-Asset Features
hypothesis.statement: Gradient boosting on cross-asset features predicts the direction of the next-day S&P 500 return better than chance.
hypothesis.null_hypothesis: The out-of-sample ROC AUC of the classifier equals 0.5.
hypothesis.alt_hypothesis: The out-of-sample ROC AUC is above 0.5 (one-sided label-permutation p < 0.05).
hypothesis.methodology: Walk-forward HistGradientBoostingClassifier with embargo, logistic baseline and label-permutation AUC test
hypothesis.summary_findings: GBM AUC 0.5068 (p=0.3081), logistic 0.4894, accuracy 53.1% vs majority 54.7%.
